name: Specialized Engineering
summary: Integrated engineering and project support services covering approvals, design, procurement, planning, cost control, and commercial management across the full project lifecycle.

introSection.title: SPECIALIZED ENGINEERING
introSection.description: Alrabat SE provides multidisciplinary engineering and project support services from early planning and approvals through execution, cost control, and commercial management. We work closely with clients, consultants, and authorities to ensure compliant, efficient, and well-coordinated delivery.

services.title: AUTHORITIES NOCs
services.description: Management and coordination of authority approvals and No Objection Certificates with local entities.

services.title: DESIGN & CONSULTATIONS
services.description: Foundation design and engineering consultancy tailored to site conditions, structural requirements, and project objectives.

services.title: PROCUREMENT SERVICES
services.description: Support for materials, equipment, and specialist procurement aligned with schedules and quality requirements.

services.title: COST ANALYSIS
services.description: Detailed budgeting, cost control, and value optimization across all project stages.

services.title: PLANNING SERVICES
services.description: Project planning, scheduling, and progress monitoring to align design, procurement, and construction.

services.title: COMMERCIAL SERVICES
services.description: Commercial support including contract administration, variations, and payment certification.

name: Foundations
summary: Comprehensive foundation and ground support solutions from site preparation to deep foundations and slope stabilization.

introSection.title: FOUNDATION & GROUND SUPPORT
introSection.description: Alrabat Foundation delivers end-to-end foundation systems tailored to project and ground conditions. Our solutions support residential, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure developments with safe, efficient, and technically robust execution.

services.title: ENABLING & SITE PREPARATION
services.description: Site preparation, fencing and hoarding, temporary facilities, vegetation removal, leveling, excavation, earthworks, and temporary access roads.

services.title: SHORING & EXCAVATION SUPPORT
services.description: Temporary and permanent shoring systems designed to suit site constraints and excavation depths.

services.title: PILING & DEEP FOUNDATIONS
services.description: Driven piles, bored piles, micropiles, and CFA/CCFA piles to deliver load-bearing capacity and stability.

services.title: SOIL REINFORCEMENT & SLOPE STABILIZATION
services.description: Soil nailing, anchors, rock bolting, tiebacks, and stabilization measures for long-term ground stability.

capabilities: Micro shoring piles & trench sheet shoring

name: Ground Improvement
summary: Specialized ground improvement solutions that enhance soil performance and provide efficient alternatives to deep foundations.

introSection.title: GROUND IMPROVEMENT SERVICES
introSection.description: Alrabat Ground Improvement delivers solutions to enhance soil strength, stability, and long-term performance across a wide range of developments.

services.title: VIBRO COMPACTION
services.description: Densifies loose granular soils and reclaimed land to improve stiffness and reduce settlement.

services.title: RIGID INCLUSIONS (CMC)
services.description: Transfers loads to competent strata while controlling total and differential settlement in soft soils.

services.title: VIBRO REPLACEMENT (STONE COLUMNS)
services.description: Improves bearing capacity and controls settlement in weak soils while reducing liquefaction risk.

services.title: DYNAMIC COMPACTION
services.description: High-energy surface impacts to improve deep loose fills and reclaimed ground.

services.title: DYNAMIC REPLACEMENT
services.description: Forms load-bearing columns in very soft or heterogeneous soils where compaction is ineffective.

services.title: RAPID IMPACT COMPACTION (RIC)
services.description: Improves near-surface soils for industrial slabs and restricted-height sites.

services.title: GROUTING SOLUTIONS
services.description: Stabilizes soil, fills voids, and reduces permeability beneath structures.

services.title: STORMWATER DRAINAGE

services.title: SEWERAGE SYSTEMS

services.title: WATER SUPPLY NETWORKS

services.title: IRRIGATION NETWORKS

services.title: UTILITY CORRIDORS

services.title: EARTHWORKS

services.title: PIPE JACKING
services.description: Trenchless installation of pipelines beneath roads and infrastructure with minimal surface disruption.

services.title: MICRO-TUNNELING
services.description: High-precision, remotely guided pipeline installation in sensitive or congested areas.
